question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He is one of those students who ***has never cheated.***
solution:
The correct answer is '**have never cheated**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The phrase "**have never cheated**" is the correct form to match the subject "**those students**," which is plural. 
 
• The usage of "**has**" in the original sentence is incorrect because it does not agree with the plural subject. 
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"He is one of those students who **have never cheated**__."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: "have never been cheating"** is incorrect because the continuous tense does not fit the context of a general statement about past behavior. 
 
• **Option 3: "had never cheated"** is incorrect because it implies a past perfect tense that does not fit the sentence structure. 
 
• **Option 4: "have ever cheated"** is incorrect because "ever" contradicts the intended meaning of the sentence.
